card.title: What Does the Winner Get?
card.instruction: Accept competitive claims, but keep asking who benefits, who pays, and what actually changes after the result.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely trophy. Who pays to insure it while it's in my house?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The winner. We can display it here if you'd rather.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Does that transfer the insurance bill to the club?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. We'd ask you to polish it before open days.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How many open days? I'd like to compare the insurance with the unpaid shifts.

mechanism: A accepts a trophy win while auditing the insurance and labor costs of each prize arrangement.
confusable: Unlike refusing recognition, A must trace who pays after the offered solution changes responsibility.
comparison: S214-a compares insurance with polishing shifts; S214-b tests whether a committee vote adds more domestic labor.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
